extracted.name: Flax and Sunflower Seed Bread
extracted.description: This is a great bread for seed lovers, one of the tastiest I’ve tried.
instruction_lines: Place all ingredients (except sunflower seeds) in the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer. Select Basic White Cycle; press Start. Add the sunflower seeds when the alert sounds during the Knead Cycle.
